rules: Fit true-shooting, turnover, and offensive-rebound RAPM separately within each season.
Weight true-shooting opportunity rows by 2 times FGA plus 0.88 times FTA.
Fit separate offense and defense mappers; define predicted net as their sum.
Select ridge alpha using 2024 to predict 2025, then refit on 2024-25 and diagnose on reused 2026.
Use square-root minimum-side target possessions as player-season weights, never as features.
Do not interpret reconstruction coefficients as causal factor weights or a production player rating.
